instruction: In the academicpages template at ~/Code/Website, change the employer name in _config.yml to 'MIT'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated file manager to ~/Code/Website/academicpages.github.io, opened _config.yml in text editor, attempted Find & Replace but used wrong search values. Then switched to terminal with grep/sed/nano but ultimately failed to correctly update all 3 required YAML fields.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate file system via file manager, open files in text editor, use Find & Replace dialog, open terminal, use grep/sed/nano commands, navigate to correct directory paths.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model confused field values during Find & Replace, used incorrect search strings, and failed to properly edit all 3 YAML fields. The multi-field requirement caused confusion between similar field names.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single YAML field edit (author.employer). The 'employer' field is unique in the file ('Red Brick University' -> 'MIT'), making Find & Replace straightforward without confusion.
metadata.explanation: Task requires editing the author.employer field in _config.yml from 'Red Brick University' to 'MIT'. Evaluator uses official check_json metric with is_yaml option and vm_file getter to verify the nested YAML field value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches _config.yml from the right path on the VM
Metric check_json with is_yaml=true correctly parses YAML and checks nested key path ['author', 'employer'] with eq method against 'MIT'
Postconfig sends Ctrl+S to save the file before evaluation, ensuring fresh state
Complete coverage: instruction requires only one change (employer to MIT), evaluator verifies exactly that
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file returns file path, check_json reads and parses it, handles None gracefully
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: postconfig Ctrl+S assumes a text editor is focused; if the agent used terminal-based editing (sed/nano), the save may be unnecessary but harmless

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
